prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic close-up shot of a person with long, curly hair, focusing intently on something just out of frame. The camera is positioned at eye level, capturing only the upper half of the face—forehead, expressive eyes, and thick eyebrows—while the lower part is obscured by a soft, out-of-focus blue foreground element, suggesting the subject is looking at a screen or device. The lighting is natural and diffused, highlighting the texture of the skin and the subtle reflections in the eyes, creating a sense of concentration and introspection. The color palette is cool, dominated by soft blues and neutral skin tones, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and foreground, drawing all attention to the subject’s gaze. The overall mood is contemplative and intimate, evoking a sense of quiet focus and immersion in thought or digital activity.
